comment: She is one of the best professors I had this semester. She is very smart, relatable, and caring. She offers good comments and is encouraging. Arabic is a hard language, but she teaches the course in a way that makes you feel confident about studying it.
Jumana is truly a great teacher. She greatly built up my confidence in speaking and articulating myself in Arabic.

Jumana is one of the most impressive professors I've studied with at Richmond. She is a fantastic teacher who is clear in her explanations and is very knowledgeable on how to teach this subject. She does a great job balancing group work, projects, activities, and coursework.
The professor was very well-organized, punctual, helpful, and respectful towards each and everyone of the students in her class.

Prof. Al-Ahmad is one of the best Arabic teachers I've had. She is professional and prepared, expects a lot from her students, and is prepared to help us in any way to succeed. Her attitude and patience in class were always exceptionally great. I can only say that I would recommend any student pursuing Arabic to be sure to have a class with her.
